sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: InvConv2d only; initialization is state provenance, not a repeated forward QR/LU.

sourceFacts: The 1x1 weight is square and mixes channels at each pixel; determinant scales by H*W.
The learned weight is initialized with QR once. Forward uses slogdet in float64 then casts the logabsdet to float32.
Reverse uses an explicit matrix inverse, outside the selected forward view.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
